narration.full_text: Let's delve into the fascinating structure of the human brain. The brain is a complex organ responsible for controlling our thoughts, emotions, movements, and essential bodily functions. Here, we see a detailed diagram illustrating its various parts. The human brain is broadly divided into three main parts: the fore-brain, the mid-brain, and the hind-brain. Each of these parts has specialized functions that contribute to the overall working of our body. The fore-brain is often considered the main thinking part of the brain. It is responsible for higher cognitive functions such as voluntary actions, memory, emotions, and processing sensory information.

visual_beats.description: Title: Structure and Function of the Human Brain

Diagram of the human brain with labels: Cerebrum, Cranium (skull), Corpus callosum, Mid Brain, Hypothalamus, Pituitary gland, Pons, Medulla, Hind-Brain, Cerebellum, and Spinal cord. Fore-Brain highlighted.
Key parts of the brain: Fore-brain, Mid-brain, Hind-brain. Highlight Fore-brain.
Fore-brain functions: Voluntary actions, Memory, Emotions, Sensory processing.
